description: Get a learning path, its membership and absolute url, and all its glossary entries in recommended order. Use this to learn a topic step by step. Entries default to full explanations; compact detail returns summaries. Use list_lines to discover path IDs.

detail.description: "full" returns complete entries (default); "compact" returns summaries with links.

id.description: Learning-path ID from list_lines, for example "cloud-foundations" or "ai-foundations".

name: get_line
title: Get learning path
